items.title: Manny Gabriel Interview, 1965-07-27
items.q: INTERVIEWER: ...Barney, Big Dog, somebody. Oh that's late, that's the late.

ctx.x: Yeah, well he played with no teeth, played the tramo with no teeth in his mouth, his mother, his buddy Petit's stepdad, he raised him and Buddy Petit took his name. But anyhow, he was pretty fair. And Ambrose, you know Ambrose you see, he was a violin player, he learned how to play tramo. And Louis Prevost, you know him? No. Well he played Clannock with Louis Armstrong when they first put up the voice band. Did you ever get that name of that band?
I know there was one Judy Singleton tells about, and then the Lydie was. And some of those that played in, Barney, Big Dog, somebody. Oh that's late, that's the late.
The Clannm Anderson's ones. But that's before that time, the voice band he ever played, they made a, they had a band, and the band consisted, I'm going to start, Joe Lindsay.
